description: The Inventory of dams in Germany, published by GFZ Data Services, lists 530 dams with 15 attributes and geographic point locations. Fields include dam name, construction and commissioning dates, state, river, height, crest length, lake area and volume, purpose, type and building characteristics. A WGS 1984 shapefile and tab-separated files provide the inventory, abbreviation tables and the source used for each dam. Downloads are free under CC-BY-4.0. The inventory can locate water-storage and flood-defence assets, parameterise reservoir networks and connect hydropower or water-supply functions in infrastructure simulations. It complements global dam inventories such as data-grand-global-reservoir-and-dam-database with German source documentation and structural fields. It is a published inventory snapshot, not a stream of current operating levels, condition inspections or gate settings. Multi-purpose dams require care when allocating capacity between uses. The public landing page rendered only its title in the reader; attribute and licence details were verified from the repository’s DataCite metadata, without opening measurement files.
